release: PATCH on 6.1.1. Both fixes were found by the operator reading a real report, not by the test suite. FIX 1 - sitemap membership is THREE-VALUED, not two. A This-page run deliberately never fetches the sitemap (the single-page contract), and inSitemap defaulted to FALSE, so the table printed a dash meaning not-in-sitemap for a URL that IS in the sitemap - proven by the whole-site run on the same page. false asserts we looked and it is not listed; nothing had looked. It is now null when unknown, the summary carries sitemapKnown, and the table renders yes / no / not checked with a footer that says why. Same defect class as the dead-host green tick and redirect-means-absent: not-looked and not-there must never render the same, which is the one rule this engine is built on. FIX 2 - Pages audited 92 of 119 read as though the crawl gave up on 27. It had not: every discovered URL was requested and 27 answered as redirects or errors, which are not pages to audit. The panel now states the breakdown by status and distinguishes NOT REACHED (unknown) from NOT A PAGE (known and fine), because the bare fraction cannot tell those apart and they mean opposite things.
